workItem: Generalize observed active-PR build/test root causes into bounded PR autofix rules, harden Decision/Evidence convergence, and project those rules into the read-only Control Panel fix algorithm.
workItemDE: Wiederkehrende Build-/Test-Root-Causes aktiver PRs als begrenzte PR-Autofix-Regeln verallgemeinern, Decision-/Evidence-Konvergenz gegen parallele Writer und generische Re-Runs härten und diese Regeln in den read-only Control-Panel-Fixalgorithmus projizieren.
priorityReason: Stale repository projections and brittle work-graph expectations currently cause avoidable full CI failures across otherwise valid PRs.
boundaries: No test suppression or expectation rewriting to a new concrete slice number
Repository repair remains exact-signature/path allowlisted and generation-bound
Control Panel remains a read-only projection and gains no mutation or merge authority
Canonical v1.7 Decision/Evidence PR-body mutation is owned only by PR Decision Evidence Reconciler
Governance reruns require an observed production-baseline write or deterministic metadata repair; unchanged failures are never generically retried
The 45,000-minute GitHub Actions state is classified as a protected blocker and is never autonomously repaired
Deterministic CI expectation repair requires an individually registered repairer plus exact declared evidence tokens
exitGate: Observed PR build/test failures are repaired only through individually registered evidence-bound repairers; Decision/Evidence drift has one canonical writer; Governance reruns occur only after proven baseline/metadata mutation; the 45k Actions state remains a protected blocker; and the Control Panel projects the bounded finding-to-fix mapping without mutation authority.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, close, supersession or abandonment.
